source.section: Liquidity and Capital Resources · Capital Expenditures
source.quote: Total capital expenditures for property and equipment and capitalized software were $27 million and $37 million for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

source.section: Liquidity and Capital Resources · Capital Stock Transactions
source.quote: We repurchased 1,740,000 shares of FNF common stock under the 2024 Repurchase Program during the three months ended March 31, 2026 for approximately $82 million

source.section: Liquidity and Capital Resources · Cash Requirements
source.quote: We paid dividends of $0.52 per share in the first quarter of 2026, or approximately $140 million to our common shareholders.

source.section: Recent Developments · F&G Life Re Ltd.
source.quote: Consideration for the sale included cash received of approximately $102 million and a 19.9% limited partnership interest in Ancient
